resources.string: Upload and restore native backups on your WebDAV server. Connections and credentials stay on this device. Scheduled uploads and retention are off initially. Your server must support PUT, MOVE and PROPFIND; external redirects are not followed.
Upload your native backup, including library, reading state, settings and saved covers, to this connection? Source content and connection passwords are not included.
Manual list, upload and restore actions use the current connection.
Remove older backups uploaded by this device

After a successful upload, remove only this connection’s older backups whose saved ownership and server version still match. Other devices’ files and modified backups are kept. Servers without strong ETags keep all backups.
Remove the saved connection and stop its scheduled uploads? Remote backups are kept.
No native backups found in this collection
Download %1$s? You can choose sections and merge behavior in the native restore dialog before restoring anything.
New password (empty keeps the saved password)
Allow unencrypted HTTP for this LAN address
